create_StreamingMean: create a StreamingMean instance with a specified shape and dtype for computing streaming tensor means
submit_value_to_StreamingMean: submit a single or batch tensor value to the StreamingMean to refine the running mean estimate
get_StreamingMean_value: get the current streaming mean value by accessing the value property of a StreamingMean instance
get_StreamingMean_count: get the number of submitted samples by accessing the count property of a StreamingMean instance
clear_StreamingMean: clear the StreamingMean statistics and return the final mean estimate before resetting sum and count to zero
